Nine-Fingers Keene is the human Guildmaster of the Guild in the city of Baldur's Gate.[2]
“
I haven't got the slightest idea what he's trying to say.
„
— Nine-Fingers Keene, when Minsc tells her that he will dislodge her 'wicked rump'

Involvement

Nine-Fingers Keene is in the Guildhall in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate and can provide information on finding  Minsc. If  Jaheira speaks with her, Keene refers to Jaheira as a hero, claims that Jaheira owes her money, and makes note of allowing a Harper to walk 'unholed' through the Guildhall.

If Minsc is present when the party visits again, Nine-Fingers tells him he was a hero of hers when she was younger. Minsc and Boo can offer to join the Guild as Nine-Fingers' 'Berserker Lodge', after the Absolute is slain.

Nine-Fingers Keene can help the party in the final fight if they side with the Guild instead of the Zhentarim at the end of the quest ⁠Aid the Underduke, allowing her personal bodyguards to be summoned with  Gather Your Allies. The inspiration ⁠Woman of Her Word is granted to party members with the  Charlatan background.
